description: Appends to the Active Context. Rejects if failed=true but no self_heal_strategy is provided. Warns if context is too large.

action.description: A short description of what was just done

failed.description: Set to true if this step encountered an error or failed to achieve its micro-goal.

result.description: The output, success, or failure message of the action

self_heal_strategy.description: MANDATORY if failed=true. How you plan to fix this failure or what alternative tool you will explore next.

name: log_step
